title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! What a haul! You're awesome!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. Do ya mind if I give these to my little brothers back home?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know they'll be super happy, and I wanna brag to 'em about ya!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll tell 'em you're really cool and super good at games and stuff!
